thread:
jordan: FYI console shows v2 badge as 100% live but routing traces still show ~20% lingering v1 traffic. not breaking, but customers are misreading the badge.

sarah: saw this too. Dashboard rollup uses a 5m aggregation which hides short-lived divergence.

pm-ian: is this a telemetry delay or routing config drift? customers are acting on the badge.

jordan: looks like telemetry lag + sampled route-probes. config says all traffic -> v2, but probes sampled at 1% miss intermittent v1 fallback traffic.

leo: quick debug: increased probe sampling locally and saw v1 variants still receiving requests due to region failover. our logs show `x-fallback-reason: capacity` on those v1 hits.

maria: UX suggestion: add "observed vs configured" indicator. if observed_v1_pct > 5% for >2m show amber state and a tooltip explaining sampling/freshness.

sarah: also add an explicit "last-live-probe" timestamp and a Refresh button that triggers an immediate high-sample probe for 30s. cheap and actionable.

pm-ian: agree. For deprecations we should always surface the live-probe confidence so customers don't retire quotas based on stale UI.

jordan: proposed rules: 1) rollout tile default window -> 60s for the tile only, 2) show last_probe_ts + trace_coverage, 3) if config != observed and observed_v1_pct >= 5% for >120s, show amber badge and back-link to traces.

leo: implementation note: switching aggregator window to 60s increases cost. we can limit to tiles tagged as "active-deprecation" to contain expense. also will need a rollout_tiles.schema bump.

pm-ian: acceptable if scoped. Add alerting: an Ops alert if discrepancy >10% for >3m. runbook should include quick mitigation: run immediate probe, check region capacity, toggle failover routes.

maria: copy for tooltip: "Observed routing is delayed by up to ~3m and sampled. Use Refresh to run a live probe (temporary higher sampling) and view traces for details."

sarah: will mock the banner + Refresh button. include a small confirmation modal when Refresh is clicked to avoid accidental cost spikes.

jordan: action items: leo -> prototype aggregator change + perf estimate; sarah -> mock UX and modal copy; maria -> update deprecation doc language; pm-ian -> update runbook thresholds. post PRs here.

ops-bot: scheduled: rollout-metrics-updater schema migration planned 2025-02-12 -> 2025-02-19.

leo: will open branch and include migration notes. aiming for demo tomorrow.

jordan: OK team. one operational reminder: don't rely solely on console badge to flip quotas until the live-probe confidence is green. :+1:

ops-bot: noted and logged: incident-preventative-checklist updated."
